name: RCPA Visit Summary
report_script:
def execute(filters=None):
    columns = [
        {"label": "Visit Date", "fieldname": "date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 120},
        {"label": "Chemist", "fieldname": "chemist", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Chemist", "width": 180},
        {"label": "Doctor", "fieldname": "doctor", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Doctor", "width": 180},
        {"label": "Rx Count", "fieldname": "rx_count", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 100},
        {"label": "Remarks", "fieldname": "remarks", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 200}
    ]

    data = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT
            rv.date,
            rv.chemist,
            rd.doctor,
            rd.rx_count,
            rd.remarks
        FROM `tabRCPA Visit` rv
        LEFT JOIN `tabRCPA Doctor` rd ON rd.parent = rv.name
        WHERE rv.docstatus != 2
        ORDER BY rv.date DESC
    """, as_dict=1)

    return columns, data
